title: Explicit Live Activation Unlocks
rules: Implement one subphase at a time.

Do not enable provider/model calls, agent dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, project mutation, DB writes, deploy, release, export, package creation, network calls, or provider spend unless the subphase explicitly scopes that lane.

Do not modify projects/**, careloop/**, generated app Sources/Tests, providers/**, tools/**, worker-runtime/**, db/**, prisma/**, migrations/**, deploy/**, release/**, exports/**, packages/**, or .env*.
Do not expose DemoApp, raw logs, raw JSON dumps, policy dumps, raw private IDs, or fake runnable actions in Command Center primary UX.
reuseRequired: existing Live Readiness rows, tabs, cards, badges, evidence, activity, audit, and cost helpers

subphases.objective: Define explicit activation contract lanes before any live unlock can be considered.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.dataShape: Result envelope with schemaVersion, currentState, readinessLabel, laneSummary, lanes[], nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, commandCenterVisible, and all runtime flags false. Each lane has laneId, label, ownerCapability, unlockState, allowedOperations, forbiddenOperations, requiredGates, requiredEvidence, blockers, nextAction, disabledReason, rollbackRequired, validationCommands, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, and costImpact.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: Preserve Live Readiness UX. Produce display-safe contract data with state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner, evidence, activity, and cost impact. Do not add runnable actions.
playwrightTests: No Playwright required in P87.1 because rendered Command Center routes are preserved.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm all runtime flags are false.
Confirm no raw private IDs or fake runnable actions appear.
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): define explicit live activation contract"
finalResponseChecklist: Docs, roadmap, and OS phase status updates

subphases.objective: Validate redacted secret and provider profile readiness without provider calls or spend.
Define local agent dispatch admission without dispatching agents.
Define generated project workspace admission without project source mutation.
Expose explicit live unlock state in Command Center without runnable actions.
Aggregate P87 tests, docs, reports, roadmap, and status evidence.
Close P87 with final validation and handoff.
